month_to_date_note: null means unknown, not zero. The budget gate treats null as 'cannot evaluate' and says so out loud.

readings.detail: AWS Cost Explorer API needs credentials and a billing-enabled account. Missing environment: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION. Method once available: boto3 cost-explorer GetCostAndUsage.
Actions minutes are only visible to an authenticated owner. Missing environment: GITHUB_TOKEN. Method once available: GitHub API /users/{owner}/settings/billing/actions.
Vercel usage requires an authenticated team account. Missing environment: VERCEL_TOKEN. Method once available: Vercel API /v2/usage.
